source.title: Effect of Drip Irrigation and Soil Amendments on Water Use Efficiency in Cotton under Semi-Arid Conditions

knowledge.evidence: Drip irrigation increased water-use efficiency by 24% compared with flood irrigation in cotton under semi-arid conditions. Application of organic manure increased soil organic carbon by 0.3 g/kg relative to the control treatment over one cropping season. Contour bunding reduced runoff and soil loss by 18% compared with the conventional tillage plots at the watershed outlet. Soil pH increased from 6.2 to 6.8 following gypsum application on sodic soils.
